lines.t: Verse 1
Brushstrokes gold, the leaves unfold,
A quiet song the wind has told.
You speak in colors, soft and slow,
Where gentle rivers, autumn flow.
Chorus
I catch Your splendor in the fall,
Every leaf a whispered call.
You are the song the forest sings,
The quiet peace that autumn brings.
Verse 2
Eagles ride the open sky,
While flowers hum a lullaby.
Your hand is felt in earth and air,
In every moment You are there.
Chorus
I catch Your splendor in the fall,
Every leaf a whispered call.
You are the song the forest sings,
The quiet peace that autumn brings.
Eagles ride the open sky,
While flowers hum a lullaby.
Your hand is felt in earth and air,
In every moment You are there.
Bridge
Rustling leaves, a soft refrain,
Nature’s hymn of love remains.
Painter of the dusk and dawn,
In Your light, I’m never gone.
Outro
Behold Your hand in every hue,
In autumn’s dance, I’m drawn to You.
Behold Your hand in every hue,
In autumn’s dance, I’m drawn to You.
